name: Iris
source:
The third demon created by Makoto.
Unlike the other demons, she wears western clothing and always carries around a stuffed toy named Axy. Iris is a telepath, a fact that allows her to link the minds of Makoto and all of his demons in order for them to communicate more easily regardless of distance. However, precisely due to those powers, she has trouble speaking directly to people, so she stutters and stammers quite often in person.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751450/Nanairo_Reincarnation/]Steam[/url]]
